Nutty Millet Porridge
By: Genevieve Sherrow
Published: Tuesday, February 23, 2010 - 4:45pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup dry hulled millet
2 1/2 cups water
Pinch of sea salt
1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds
1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, crushed
2 teaspoons butter
2 tablespoons maple syrup
1/8 cup of dried fruit (cranberries, raisins, or currants)

Preparation

1 Heat a dry pot to medium. Add millet. Stir millet with a wooden spoon. After a few minutes the grains will begin to pop and give off a nutty aroma. Add water and salt and bring to a boil. Simmer for approximately 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Millet will soften like a porridge. 2 Stir in sesame and sunflower seeds. Add butter and maple syrup and stir. Taste and adjust salt or syrup. Ladle into your favorite breakfast bowl. Top with dried fruit of your choice.

About


Millet is a high protein, whole grain and great for special diets. This nutty, sweet hot breakfast cereal will give you the energy you need to kick start your day.
